wiki:
How to obtain: find 10 hidden room dungeon discoveries.

List of hidden room dungeon discoveries:

Dungeon : Syracuse Church

Upper: none
Middle: A Marble Statue of Archimedes (Historical Relic)

Dungeon: Rome Church

Upper: Buried Glassware (Historical Relic)
Middle: Sarcophagus (Historical Relic)

Statue of Chasca (Historical Relic)
